title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, who once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces and chart out an inspirational path of freedom against the despotic rulers.

title: DJ: Duvvada Jagannadham
desc: Duvvada Jagannatham Sastry, an honest man, goes to great lengths to help other people. A police officer notices this quality of his and asks him to moonlight as a crime fighter.

title: Tagaru Palya
desc: After a villager secures a marriage alliance with a city boy for his only daughter, he prepares to offer a sacrifice to the gods. However, things go awry during the ceremony.

title: Leader
desc: Vijay is a rebellious law student who boldly criticises the government, flirts with a beautiful woman and invites trouble. But his life changes when he is accused of assassinating a politician.

title: Bharjari
desc: Surya, an orphan raised by the best friend of his deceased mother, wants to become a soldier. He falls in love with a woman but soon gets an offer to join the army.
